title: Splash cold water on your face
description: A quick jolt to the nervous system that interrupts the urge and resets your focus.

title: Box breathing
description: In for 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4. Two minutes settles the body's alarm.

title: Do push-ups until you can't
description: Burn off the surge of energy. Physical effort discharges the tension an urge rides on.

title: Take a cold shower
description: Uncomfortable, effective, and it changes your state fast.

title: Step outside for fresh air
description: Change your environment. New surroundings break the automatic loop.

title: Stretch your whole body
description: Release physical tension from head to toe. Slow and deliberate.

title: Text someone you trust
description: Connection is the opposite of the isolation the loop feeds on. Even a small hello counts.

title: Make a hot drink, slowly
description: A small ritual of self-care. Do it with full attention.

title: Walk around the block
description: Movement plus a change of scene. Notice five things you can see.

title: Write down what you're feeling
description: Get the urge out of your head and onto the page. Naming it drains its charge.

title: Call someone
description: Hearing a voice you care about pulls you back into the real world.

title: Tidy one small space
description: A quick win that changes your environment and gives a sense of control.

title: Do a body-scan meditation
description: Move attention slowly through the body. It grounds you in the present.

title: Play or listen to music fully
description: Let a few songs move you. Engage a different reward pathway.

title: Go for a run
description: Longer effort resets mood and burns off restlessness for hours.

title: See a friend in person
description: Real connection is the strongest antidote. Make the plan now.
